text:
Alex K: quick check — i'm about to land a terraform change that moves per-model ConfigMaps into per-model namespaces (model-<id>-cfg) instead of a shared 'models-config' ns. goal is better RBAC isolation + easier gc. thinking through rollout + reconciliation concerns. pinging infra for risks.
Priya S: can you paste the tf diff? curious about how the k8s provider is being used.
Alex K: sure, short snippet: 
```hcl
resource \"kubernetes_namespace\" \"model_ns\" {
  for_each = toset(local.model_ids)
  metadata { name = \"model-${each.value}-cfg\" }
}
resource \"kubernetes_config_map\" \"model_cm\" {
  for_each = toset(local.model_ids)
  metadata { name = \"permodel-config\" namespace = kubernetes_namespace.model_ns[each.key].metadata[0].name }
  data = local.model_config_map[each.key]
}
```
Mario R: main risk is that old consumers expect the cm in the shared ns. do we have any code that hardcodes namespace?
Alex K: good call. runtime looks up namespace from env var MODEL_CONFIG_NS but defaults to models-config. i added a fallback in runtime PR but want infra to do a gradual rollout.
Jen L: what's the plan for rollout? can we do a shadow copy first (write duplicates) for an hour and then flip env var?
Alex K: plan A: TF apply creates model namespaces + new CMS alongside old ones. then canary deploy runtime pointing to new ns for 10% of traffic. after validation, update deployment env var cluster-wide and remove old CMS.
Sam O: who owns the canary? i can wire a traffic split in the ingress rules, but need a stable label we can target.
Alex K: can you make a short canary k8s patch with label `configns-canary: true` and i'll update service routing.
Priya S: also watch secrets — we put some keys referenced by ConfigMaps via sync-controller into the shared ns. moving may break the secret sync controller if it assumes same namespace.
Mario R: yep, sync-controller currently maps secrets by name across namespaces but only if target ns is in a allowlist. tf change must add new model namespaces to secret sync allowlist or we risk 403s.
Alex K: ok i'll include allowlist changes in the tf diff. didnt want to touch that but sounds required.
Jen L: one more thing — KMS/arn scopes: ops asked we verify IAM role that reads kms has permission across created namespaces.
Alex K: noted. i'll add serviceaccount bindings in the tf module.
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/6123 — "per-model-ns-configs + cm move" (alexk)
Priya S: checking PR now. quick find: the namespace resource uses `for_each = local.model_ids` which might reorder on list diff; use `toset()` is fine but prefer map with stable keys. small nits.
Alex K: updated to use map-of-ids, pushed new commit.
Sam O: ops-bot, any warning if secret-sync allowlist expands to 200+ namespaces?
ops-bot: alert: secret-sync controller scales linearly with target namespaces. expected memory + watch fds will increase. recommend staggered apply and monitor controller heap.
Mario R: for safety we should batch applies (50 namespaces at a time) and watch controller metrics. also add a temporary alert on `secret_sync_failed_total` > 0 for 5m during rollout.
Jen L: agree. also add a preflight terraform plan check in CI that runs `kubectl get cm -n <ns>` against a staging cluster to detect consumers that read from old ns only.
Alex K: good idea — i'll add a smoke test step to the PR that deploys a small pod to read both var paths and fails if only old ns exists.
Priya S: i left review comments re: role bindings and SA name collisions. also asked for explicit ownerReferences on the CMS so garbage collection is predictable.
Sam O: once infra PR is green and smoke test passes, i'll coordinate canary deployment window (tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC).
Alex K: thanks. final ask: @jen @mario can you shepherd the controller alerts during rollout? will post status in this thread.
Jen L: happy to. i'll watch dashboards and poke on-call if alarms fire. :eyes:
Mario R: i'll handle secret-sync metrics and be oncall during the window.
Alex K: thanks all — landing tf change in ~30m to create namespaces only (no cm updates), will follow-up with next PR for config population + canary.
deploy-bot: deploy requested: infra/tf -> plan queued by alexk
Priya S: ack, will re-review once second PR lands.
Alex K: thread update later with plan link + canary playbook.
Sam O: ping @alexk if you need a quick rollback script for routing.
Alex K: will do. :thumbsup:
